title: Postgres instance
description: One member of the Patroni cluster from postgres_exporter: activity, throughput, I/O, checkpoints, locks, wraparound and settings. Database picker for the per-database panels.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: pg_up: postgres_exporter can log in as pgmon.

panels.title: Cache hit
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared_buffers over the time range (selected databases).

targets.expr: sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres", host="$host", datname=~"$datname"}[$__range])) / (sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres", host="$host", datname=~"$datname"}[$__range])) + sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="postgres", host="$host", datname=~"$datname"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Deadlocks / conflicts
panels.description: In the time range. Conflicts: queries on a replica cancelled by replay.

panels.title: Backends by user
panels.description: postgres: Patroni (heartbeat, REST API); pgmon: postgres_exporter; replicator: walsenders/receivers; the rest are the apps' roles.

panels.title: Waiting active backends
panels.description: Active backends that wait for something: Lock (blocked by another session), IO (disk), LWLock, Client.

targets.expr: sum by (wait_event_type, wait_event) (pg_stat_activity_count{job="postgres", host="$host", state="active", wait_event_type!=""}) > 0

panels.title: Rows read per second
panels.description: Returned much larger than fetched: sequential scans reading rows they then filter out.

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres", host="$host", datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres", host="$host", datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="postgres", host="$host", datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Blocks read from disk / hit
panels.description: 8 KiB blocks: from the OS (page cache or Ceph RBD) vs from shared_buffers.

panels.title: Temp files written
panels.description: Sorts and hashes that didn't fit in work_mem spill to disk.

defaults.noValue: Needs postgres_exporter's stat_checkpointer collector (postgres.tf, not applied yet)
No transaction open longer than a minute (long_running_transactions collector)

panels.title: Transaction ID age (wraparound)
panels.description: age(datfrozenxid) per database (the metric says _seconds but it's transactions). Autovacuum freezes at 200 M; trouble starts near 2 billion.

defaults.noValue: Needs postgres_exporter's database_wraparound collector (postgres.tf, not applied yet)

panels.title: Key settings
panels.description: The settings this cluster tunes or depends on (Patroni's bootstrap.dcs and postgresql.parameters). Sizes in bytes, times in seconds, booleans 1/0. Missing rows: the setting doesn't exist under that name in this version.

panels.title: Settings that differ between members
panels.description: Settings whose value isn't the same on all members (count of distinct values > 1). Normally empty: Patroni applies the same parameters everywhere; a difference means a pending restart or a hand edit. patroni_pending_restart says which member still runs the old value.

defaults.noValue: All members run the same settings
